newsitem.title: HONG KONG: RUGBY UNION-CANADA BEAT HONG KONG 35-27 IN PACIFIC RIM MATCH.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-CANADA BEAT HONG KONG 35-27 IN PACIFIC RIM MATCH.

text.p: HONG KONG, May 24, Reuter - Canada beat Hong Kong 35-27 (halftime 3-24) in their Pacific Rim championship rugby union match at the Aberdeen Stadium on Saturday
Hong Kong - Tries: Paul Dingley, Luke Nabaro, Carl Murray, Riaz Fredericks. Conversions: Chris Gordon (2). Penalty: Gordon.
Canada - Tries: Winston Stanley, Steve Gray, Colin McKenzie. Conversion: Bob Ross. Penalties: Ross (4). Drop goals: Ross (2).
